rubric_items.reason: Extends the existing GET /api/patients/:id route, PatientRepo/PatientService, both PatientDetail types and PatientDetailPage, following the routes/services/repositories layering and the client-only rule. No new endpoint, table or infrastructure.

Every story and AC maps to components: server counts over all rows (S-2 AC2 vs the 100-row limit), strict-after-now upcoming, future Cancelled, tie-break, local day (S-3 AC2), date-only link, No visits yet, no sensitive columns.

Every EP-1 field has name, type, nullability, format and example. The web localDate(day) helper is not specified tightly enough to rule out a time-zone shift, and the display strings are left implicit.
Choices are cited to the module map, the architecture or IDE answers A-04 to A-06. CO-9's claim that api.patient returns PatientDetail cites only architecture#components, which does not show this.

Server vs browser counts, local day vs UTC instant, and extending the field vs a new endpoint (including the POST/PATCH side effect) are all explained. The cost line says one extra query, but the design uses two.
Clear and well structured, and the front matter matches the body. There is one small inconsistency in how the extra queries are counted.

findings.text: The new web localDate(day) helper reformats a server-computed YYYY-MM-DD day, but the design does not say it must avoid time-zone conversion. Copying dateTime's Date+timeZone pattern could shift the day and break S-3 AC2 for some zones.

findings.suggested_fix: State that localDate formats the YYYY-MM-DD string as a calendar day with no zone conversion (e.g. parse parts or format with timeZone 'UTC'), giving '10 Mar 2026' for '2026-03-10'.

findings.text: The trade-off line says the cost is one extra small query per page view, but CO-1 describes two new queries (a count query plus a latest-Completed query).

cites.quote: One extra small query per page view is cheap.
A second query takes the latest COMPLETED appointment

findings.suggested_fix: Say 'two small extra queries per page view' (or merge them into one query) so the cost line matches CO-1.

findings.text: CO-9 says api.patient already returns PatientDetail but cites only architecture#components, which names client.ts and not api.patient or its type. The fact is true in the code, so it should cite the client symbol or line.

findings.suggested_fix: Add context/generated/module-map.json#sym:sample-system:web/src/api/client.ts:api (or the client.ts line) to CO-9's cites.
